europe_now.title: Energy Ceasefire Announcement
europe_now.summary: European leaders reacted to a unilaterally announced Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire as oil prices fell following the declaration. While Ukrainian officials noted a lack of specific details and ongoing attacks on power infrastructure, EU diplomats stated they would evaluate the arrangement once it proves stable.

sources.headline: Trump says Ukraine and Russia have agreed 'energy ceasefire'
Live: Oil prices fall after Trump unilaterally announces Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire'

europe_now.title: EU Budget Discussions and Funding Disputes
europe_now.summary: Members of the European Parliament criticized proposed Irish EU budget plans, warning that substantial cuts risk causing historic failures in crisis response funding. European Commission warnings accompanied these debates, highlighting how reduced financial allocations weaken overall bloc readiness.

sources.headline: Ireland’s budget cuts weaken EU, Commission warns
MEPs warn Irish EU budget plan is ‘short‑sighted’ and risks ‘historic failure’ as cuts of €141bn spare farm and cohesion funds

top_stories.title: French Left-Wing Primary Outcome
top_stories.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann won the French center-left primary election, securing 66 percent of the vote to become a candidate for the presidency. Observers and profile coverage highlighted his emerging national political ambitions following the decisive internal party victory.

sources.headline: MEP Glucksmann wins French center-left primary, becoming candidate for presidency
🔴 Raphaël Glucksmann wins French left-wing primary with 66% of vote

top_stories.title: Kraków Mayoral Election
top_stories.summary: An independent candidate successfully defeated Prime Minister Donald Tusk's candidate in the Kraków mayoral runoff election. This local election outcome represents a notable political setback for the prime minister's broader national agenda.
